title: Russia's Nuclear Weapon in Space? What Western Intelligence Fears
description_html:
A German investigation by NDR, WDR and the Sueddeutsche Zeitung reports that Western intelligence fears Russia is preparing to launch a nuclear-armed satellite, reportedly called Sputnik-S, as early as December. We explain what is reported, what is known and not known, what Russia says, what a nuclear weapon in orbit would mean under the 1967 Outer Space Treaty, how it could affect GPS and satellites in the US, Europe, Africa, Asia, the Gulf and India, what you should do, and our honest take. No launch date and no operational nuclear payload has been publicly confirmed.
